segments.he: אֵלּוּ הֵן מַעֲמָדוֹת. לְפִי שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כּוּ׳״. מַאי קָאָמַר? הָכִי קָאָמַר: אֵלּוּ הֵן מַעֲמָדוֹת. וּמָה טַעַם תִּיקְּנוּ מַעֲמָדוֹת, לְפִי שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״צַו אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם אֶת קׇרְבָּנִי לַחְמִי לְאִשַּׁי״.
segments.en: § The mishna taught that «these are» the «non-priestly watches: Since it is stated: “Command the children of Israel.”» The Gemara asks: «What is» the mishna «saying» about the non-priestly watches? How does the verse relate to the watches? The Gemara explains that the mishna «is saying as follows:» These are the «non-priestly watches,» which will be explained later. «And what is the reason that they instituted non-priestly watches? Since it is stated: “Command the children of Israel and say to them: My offering of food, which is presented to Me made by a fire,» of a sweet savor to Me, you shall observe to sacrifice to Me in their due season” (Numbers 28:2).
